title: "Data and protocols"

## Protocols

The plot protocol is described on the [Permanent plots](plots.qmd) page. It follows the international standards of the [ForestPlots.net](https://forestplots.net) network.

## Data access

The data will soon be available through [ForestPlots.net](https://forestplots.net). In the meantime, data requests can be sent to the project [coordinator](contact.qmd).
